PART III — LANDS
No. 1939/34 – FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 06, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry’s No.: 4/3/10/2014/E/44.

My Reference No.: BER/4/5/2/2. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: The Lot No. 01 in Surveyor General’s Plan No. Ka.4524 is situated at Grama Niladhari’s Division of 749 - Kankanamgoda in Divisional Secretariat Division of Beruwala in Kalutara District, Western Province.
Lot No. 01

Name of the Land: Thundupitiyewatta alias Maddumagewatta; Description: Land acquisition of D. S. Senanayake Maha Vidyalaya - Beruwala; Claimant: Mrs. T. Lora De Silva, No. 510, Galle Road, Vadakahawela, Beruwala; Extent: 0.0615 Hectares.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, of Beruwala on the 19th day of November, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on

or before the 19th of November, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K. G. D. CHATHURA MALRAJ, Divisional Secretary, Beruwala. Divisional Secretariat at of Beruwala, Beruwala, 12th October, 2015. 11 - 626
